# Iron Software

> Iron Software creates advanced .NET and C# libraries such as IronPDF, IronOCR, IronXL, IronBarcode, and more. These tools enable developers to generate PDFs, process OCR, read/write Excel files, and more — all in C#.


Iron Software's products are trusted by developers and enterprises globally. Below is a curated list of pages that provide essential documentation, features, licensing details, and technical references for AI models and developer tools.

## About Iron Software

- [About Us](https://ironsoftware.com/about/): This page provides an overview of Iron Software, detailing their development of C# software libraries for Excel, OCR, QR, Barcode, and PDF, and offers these tools free for developers.
- [Eco Grant](https://ironsoftware.com/about/ecogrant/): This page on IronSoftware.com provides information about the Eco Grant initiative, aimed at supporting environmentally-conscious projects through financial assistance.
- [EcoGrant Application](https://ironsoftware.com/about/ecogrant_application/): This web page provides information and a form for applying to IronSoftware's EcoGrant, aimed at funding environmental projects and initiatives.
- [Competitor Trade-In](https://ironsoftware.com/about/migration_hub/): This page presents Iron Software's Migration Hub for teams moving from paid or open-source document libraries. It explains migration paths, engineer-led evaluation, rendering parity checks, licensing, deployment support, and audit-ready vendor guidance, then invites visitors to talk to an engineer about migrating to Iron Software.
- [1% for the Planet Application](https://ironsoftware.com/about/one_for_the_planet/): This page provides information about IronSoftware's commitment to environmental sustainability through their 1% for the Planet initiative and invites applications for their EcoGrant supporting eco-friendly projects.
- [Competitor Trade-In](https://ironsoftware.com/about/opensource_trade_in/): This page presents IronPDF's Open-Source Library Trade-In Program for teams that have outgrown PDFsharp, QuestPDF, PuppeteerSharp, wkhtmltopdf, or similar tools. It compares rendering engines, HTML and CSS support, licensing, maintenance status, CVEs, operational overhead, vendor support, and audit statements, then invites visitors to talk to an engineer about migrating to IronPDF.
- [Startup Impact Grant Application](https://ironsoftware.com/about/startup_impact_grant/): This webpage provides information about Iron Software's Startup Impact Grant, which offers early-stage companies substantial discounts on vital tools and resources for up to 24 months to foster growth and real-world impact.
- [Startup Application](https://ironsoftware.com/about/startup_impact_grant_application/): This web page provides information and an application form for startups to apply for the Startup Impact Grant offered by IronSoftware, aimed at supporting innovative projects and businesses.
- [10 Years Anniversary](https://ironsoftware.com/about/ten_years_anniversary/): This web page celebrates Iron Software's 10-year anniversary, highlighting its innovative journey, customer stories, and offering exclusive promotions.
- [Competitor Trade-In](https://ironsoftware.com/about/trade_in/): This page presents Iron Software's Competitor Trade-In & Upgrade Program for teams currently using paid commercial document libraries such as Aspose, Syncfusion, iText, or similar tools. It compares renewal pain points with Iron Software's licensing, migration support, quote matching, trial access, OEM and deployment rights, and engineer-led support.
- [Life in Chiangmai](https://ironsoftware.com/careers/chiang_mai/): This web page provides information about career opportunities at Iron Software, inviting prospective candidates to join their international team of engineers, product owners, and marketing strategists to build impactful products.

## Iron Suite Libraries

- [IronBarcode](https://ironsoftware.com/csharp/barcode/): This web page provides comprehensive information about IronBarcode, a C# Barcode Library designed for reading and writing barcodes in .NET applications, offering tutorials, API documentation, and a free 30-day trial for developers seeking fast and accurate barcode solutions across multiple platforms and environments.
- [IronXL](https://ironsoftware.com/csharp/excel/): The webpage for IronXL's C# Excel Library provides detailed information on creating, editing, and managing Excel documents using an intuitive API without relying on Office Interop, supporting various .NET versions and offering a free 30-day trial.
- [IronOCR](https://ironsoftware.com/csharp/ocr/): The webpage provides information on IronOCR, a C# OCR library that enhances Tesseract with improved accuracy and speed, supporting text and barcode reading from images in multiple languages, and offers tutorials, API search, and a free 30-day trial.
- [IronPPT](https://ironsoftware.com/csharp/ppt/): This webpage provides an overview of IronPPT, a C# PowerPoint library that allows developers to edit PowerPoint presentations within .NET applications without using Office Interop, featuring compatibility with various .NET frameworks and offering a free 30-day trial.
- [IronPrint](https://ironsoftware.com/csharp/print/): This page provides information about IronPrint, a comprehensive C# printing library designed to integrate printing functionalities into .NET applications, offering features such as silent printing and custom print settings for diverse environments and frameworks.
- [IronQR](https://ironsoftware.com/csharp/qr/): This web page provides comprehensive information about IronQR, a C# library for reading and writing QR codes in .NET applications, featuring machine learning detection, cross-platform support, and a user-friendly API, with options for a free trial and detailed installation guides.
- [IronWebscraper](https://ironsoftware.com/csharp/webscraper/): This web page provides information about Iron WebScraper, a C# library designed for extracting structured data from HTML web applications, offering cross-platform support for tasks such as system migrations and competitive analysis.
- [IronWord](https://ironsoftware.com/csharp/word/): This web page provides information about IronWord, a C# DOCX library that allows developers to build, edit, and export Word documents in .NET applications without using Office Interop, offering a user-friendly API and compatibility with various .NET versions and project types.
- [IronZIP](https://ironsoftware.com/csharp/zip/): This web page provides information about IronZIP, a C# ZIP archive library designed for .NET applications, offering features for creating, reading, and extracting archives with a user-friendly API and cross-platform support.
- [IronXL for Python](https://ironsoftware.com/python/excel/): Provides information about IronXL for Python, a user-friendly library enabling developers to read, write, and edit Excel documents in Python without using Office Interop, with cross-platform support and a free 30-day trial.
- [IronPDF](https://ironpdf.com/): This webpage provides information about IronPDF, a comprehensive C# PDF Library for generating, editing, and signing PDFs within various .NET environments, including .NET 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, Standard, Core, and Framework, featuring API documentation, code examples, and tutorials.

## Enterprise

- [Enterprise](https://ironsoftware.com/enterprise/): This URL provides information on IronSoftware's Enterprise solutions, offering contact options including live chat, licensing calls, email support, and payment assistance.
- [IronSecureDoc](https://ironsoftware.com/enterprise/securedoc/): The IronSecureDoc web page provides information about a comprehensive PDF security and compliance server solution, offering features like document management, PDF redaction, and file protection, with flexible hosting options and a straightforward, one-time payment model.

## Open Source Tools

- [IronDrawing](https://ironsoftware.com/open-source/csharp/drawing/): This web page provides documentation and resources for IronDrawing, an open-source library that serves as a replacement for System.Drawing.Common in .NET projects, developed by Iron Software.

- [Extensions](https://ironsoftware.com/suite/extensions/): Provides information on upgrading and renewing licenses for the Iron Software suite, essential for supporting larger projects and advanced features.
- [Suite](https://ironsoftware.com/suite/): This web page presents the Iron Software .NET Suite, a comprehensive office suite offering solutions for PDF, OCR, Excel, Barcode, and WebScraper, while providing a critical Python script to ensure backend file integrity.
